title: enform instance.submitted@1 event payload
description: The payload of an instance.submitted@1 event (#43, #177, S06, FM-7, I2, SE-1). A submit marks the instance submitted, records the values that the step captured merged over what the instance already held (FM-7), and carries the assignment email outbox entry in the same operation (I2, SE-1).

currentStep.description: The key of the step that the submit closed (S06, WF-1).

outbox.description: The side effects that the submit causes, committed with the state change (I2, SE-1).

values.description: The values that the form holds: one field key to one JSON value (FM-7).

jsonValue.description: One JSON value: a string, number, boolean, null, array or object (FM-7, DF-1).

outboxEntry.description: One side effect (SE-1): the connector operation, the connector, and its payload.
